    x_scaled = (x + 5) / 10

    quadratic_sum = 0.7 * np.sum(x_scaled**2)

    hyperbolic_interaction = 0.1 * np.tanh(np.sum(x_scaled[0:2]**2) - np.sum(x_scaled[2:4]**2))**2

    # Log-barrier term to force solutions away from the boundaries. Add small constant for numerical stability
    log_barrier = -0.01 * np.sum(np.log(x_scaled * (1 - x_scaled) + 1e-8))
